# Ottabase

> Ottabase is a Cloudflare-native foundation for shipping production SaaS, apps, and content sites: in-house auth, RBAC, an ORM over D1, forms, uploads, a blog/CMS, queues, realtime, RLS, and a runtime theming engine (Brand Engine), across 60+ packages that already know about each other.

## Start here

- [Ottabase Monorepo](README.md): Get started in five minutes → - Clone, configure, bootstrap, and ship.
- [Getting Started in 5 Minutes](QUICKSTART.md): Welcome to Ottabase: an edge-native SaaS framework for Cloudflare Workers. This guide gets you from zero to running in under 5 minutes.
- [Ottabase Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md): This document describes the architecture of the Ottabase monorepo and the runtime model used by the primary app template.
- [Agents & Architecture](AGENTS.MD): Ottabase is a Cloudflare-native foundation for shipping production SaaS, Apps, and content sites without first assembling the infrastructure. It exists because the interesting part of a product is…
- [Solo Founder's SaaS Platform Guide](docs/SOLO_FOUNDER_SAAS_GUIDE.md): Build production-ready multi-tenant SaaS from your home office

## Packages

- [@ottabase/analytics](packages/analytics/README.md): Cloudflare Workers Analytics Engine (WAE) wrapper — track events, query aggregated data, and analyze user behavior.
- [@ottabase/api](packages/api/README.md): Type-safe fetch wrapper with error handling.
- [@ottabase/audit](packages/audit/README.md): Audit logging for multi-tenant applications with RBAC context integration.
- [@ottabase/auth](packages/auth/README.md): Lightweight, dependency-free authentication for Ottabase apps on Cloudflare Workers + D1. Signed session cookies, PBKDF2 credentials, generic OAuth2/OIDC, and magic-link email sign-in — all built on…
- [@ottabase/brand-engine](packages/brand-engine/README.md): Unified theme engine for Ottabase — design tokens, preset template expansion, CSS variable injection, email branding, and brand persistence via D1.
- [@ottabase/brand-engine-react](packages/brand-engine-react/README.md): React bindings for Ottabase Brand Engine — brand config provider, theme application, and layout resolution.
- [@ottabase/cf](packages/cf/README.md): Framework-agnostic Cloudflare bindings wrapper for TypeScript applications.
- [@ottabase/cf-pdf](packages/cf-pdf/README.md): @ottabase/cf-pdf is a normal Ottabase package for secure HTML-to-PDF export on Cloudflare Workers. It combines:
- [@ottabase/cf-realtime](packages/cf-realtime/README.md): A Pusher alternative for real-time pub/sub using Cloudflare Actors (Durable Objects). Build scalable, real-time applications with WebSocket support, offline message queuing, and TypeScript-first API.
- [@ottabase/cli](packages/cli/README.md): Ottabase monorepo CLI tool for scaffolding, developing, building, and testing apps.
- [@ottabase/comments](packages/comments/README.md): Threaded comment system for Ottabase apps with polymorphic targeting, reactions, and moderation.
- [@ottabase/config](packages/config/README.md): Shared configuration utilities for Ottabase applications with environment variable support.
- [@ottabase/cron](packages/cron/README.md): Minimal cron handler for Cloudflare Workers scheduled events.
- [@ottabase/db](packages/db/README.md): Shared database layer for Ottabase applications using Drizzle ORM.
- [@ottabase/docs](packages/docs/README.md): Minimal, reusable documentation viewer for Markdown files. Clean layout with left navigation, content area, and right table of contents. Colors from Brand Kit; layout themes control spacing and…
- [@ottabase/email](packages/email/README.md): Edge-friendly email templating + mailer helpers for Ottabase.
- [@ottabase/forms](packages/forms/README.md): Auto-generated CRUD Forms for OttaORM fat models. Zero config, real-time Zod validation, works standalone or with ModelCrud.
- [@ottabase/hello-world](packages/hello-world/README.md): A simple, customizable React component that displays a friendly greeting message with beautiful default styling.
- [@ottabase/homepage-contract](packages/homepage-contract/README.md): Shared Zod contract package for homepage, marketing page, and navigation payloads.
- [@ottabase/i18n](packages/i18n/README.md): Internationalization (i18n) package for the Ottabase monorepo, built with i18next and react-i18next.
- [@ottabase/logger](packages/logger/README.md): Extensible logger for Ottabase with support for multiple transports and formatters.
- [@ottabase/medialibrary](packages/medialibrary/README.md): Shared media-library primitives for Ottabase apps.
- [@ottabase/notifications](packages/notifications/README.md): Minimalistic notifications engine for Ottabase - multi-channel user notifications, system alerts, and real-time updates.
- [@ottabase/ottaai](packages/ottaai/README.md): Tenant BYOK for AI: a user's key → an org's key → the platform default → no client. Encrypted at rest, resolved deterministically, gated server-side, and shipped with the settings UI.
- [@ottabase/ottablog](packages/ottablog/README.md): A comprehensive blog and content management system for Ottabase apps. Built on the fat model pattern with OttaORM.
- [@ottabase/ottadate](packages/ottadate/README.md): Framework-agnostic date picker library with range, datetime, and fuzzy date support. Works with any framework or vanilla JS — no React, Vue, or Angular required.
- [@ottabase/ottaeditor](packages/ottaeditor/README.md): EditorJS wrapper with 30 plugins (13 EditorJS + 17 custom blocks), type-safe plugin selection, undo/redo, and JSON/Markdown export.
- [@ottabase/ottalayout](packages/ottalayout/README.md): Layout system for Ottabase — types, presets, path resolver, validators, utility classes, and React slots.
- [@ottabase/ottamenu](packages/ottamenu/README.md): Pure menu types, renderers, and tree utilities for Ottabase — 6 built-in render types, zero persistence.
- [@ottabase/ottaorm](packages/ottaorm/README.md): An ORM for Cloudflare D1 and SQLite. Fat model pattern with all logic in one place.
- [@ottabase/ottarenderer](packages/ottarenderer/README.md): React renderer for Editor.js content and generic HTML.
- [@ottabase/ottarouter](packages/ottarouter/README.md): The simplest opinionated router for Cloudflare Workers — zero dependencies, order-free precedence, onion middleware, gated mounts, and null-based fall-through.
- [@ottabase/ottaselect](packages/ottaselect/README.md): A select component that accepts any object format and always returns a standardized output. Perfect for React applications with dynamic data sources and CrudHub integration.
- [@ottabase/ottaupload](packages/ottaupload/README.md): A file upload package with drag-and-drop UI, progress tracking, and multi-provider support for Cloudflare R2 and Cloudflare Images.
- [@ottabase/premium](packages/premium/README.md): Premium Packages framework for Ottabase apps. A server manifest declares everything a commercial add-on contributes — tables, models, routes, nav, entitlements and lifecycle hooks — and the host app…
- [@ottabase/premium-webhooks](packages/premium-webhooks/README.md): Outbound webhooks for Ottabase apps — and the worked example of a Premium Package built on @ottabase/premium.
- [@ottabase/queue](packages/queue/README.md): Minimal queue system for Cloudflare Workers. Laravel-inspired job dispatching with modular handler registration.
- [@ottabase/rbac](packages/rbac/README.md): Production-ready Role-Based Access Control with multi-tenant support and optimized caching.
- [@ottabase/referrals](packages/referrals/README.md): Referral system package for Ottabase — schema, model, validation, and attribution tracking.
- [@ottabase/scripts](packages/scripts/README.md): CLI tools for Ottabase monorepo — Cloudflare resource setup, local env secrets, and cleanup.
- [@ottabase/shortlinks](packages/shortlinks/README.md): URL shortening system for Cloudflare D1 — redirect handling, interstitial pages, expiry, and click analytics.
- [@ottabase/spotlight](packages/spotlight/README.md): Lightweight spotlight/command palette component with dark mode support, background blur effects, and configurable search.
- [@ottabase/state](packages/state/README.md): Layout structure in ThemeInfo.layout uses and re-exports the canonical LayoutConfig from @ottabase/ottalayout; state does not maintain a narrower copy of the layout variants.
- [@ottabase/ui-base](packages/ui-base/README.md): Base UI styles and utilities for Ottabase applications. This package contains framework-agnostic CSS reset, animations, and base styles.
- [@ottabase/ui-code-highlight](packages/ui-code-highlight/README.md): A lightweight, standalone code highlighting component for React applications with automatic light/dark mode support.
- [@ottabase/ui-components](packages/ui-components/README.md): Shared UI components for Ottabase applications.
- [@ottabase/ui-cropper](packages/ui-cropper/README.md): Advanced vanilla image cropper: crop, flip, rotate, zoom with smooth transitions. Square/rect/circle viewfinder. PNG/JPEG. Zero React. ~3–4 KB gzipped.
- [@ottabase/ui-datatable](packages/ui-datatable/README.md): Advanced, headless-first data table built on TanStack Table v8 for ottabase. Supports server-side sort/filter/pagination (via OttaORM), column visibility, row selection, inline editing, bulk actions,…
- [@ottabase/ui-mantine](packages/ui-mantine/README.md): Mantine UI components and providers for Ottabase applications. This package provides a comprehensive Mantine integration with pre-built themes and configuration utilities.
- [@ottabase/ui-shadcn](packages/ui-shadcn/README.md): Shared shadcn/ui components and helpers used across Ottabase applications. The package provides:
- [@ottabase/ui-split-pane](packages/ui-split-pane/README.md): Minimal, clean split-pane component for React applications with no frills.
- [@ottabase/ui-tailwind](packages/ui-tailwind/README.md): Shared Tailwind CSS preset and base styles for Ottabase apps. The preset maps theme CSS variables (shadcn-style HSL tokens, radii, fonts, charts, sidebar, etc.) to Tailwind utilities and registers…
- [@ottabase/utils](packages/utils/README.md): A set of utility functions for file operations, string manipulation, URL handling, environment detection, currency formatting, email parsing, JSON handling, git operations, and more.
